item.title: Riverhead Town Board meeting wrap: March 3
item.description: Here's a rundown of actions taken by the Riverhead Town Board at its March 3 meeting.

item.title: Riverhead senior althetes commit to colleges
item.description: Eight Riverhead High School seniors were honored yesterday during the school's annual spring signing day for senior athletes. Photos.

item.title: Medical office’s on-street parking creates hazard, residents say
item.description: A proposal to restrict parking on Northern Parkway off Roanoke Avenue in downtown Riverhead drew criticism from some neighboring residents who said parking restrictions alone would not address the source of the problem.

item.title: Never a friend to the environment, Zeldin has been a ‘wrecking ball’ as chief of EPA
item.description: Deregulatory actions taken by the EPA with Zeldin at the helm, including eliminating vehicle emissions standards, harm rather than protect the environment and put human health at risk: lawsuit.

item.title: A first look at Riverhead schools ’26-’27 budget: $218.9 M plan stays within tax cap: budget official
item.description: The biggest drivers of spending increases in the coming year: special education, benefits, charter school tuition, Riverhead's business official said.

item.title: 2% transfer tax revenues rose in 2025 and .5% housing fund tax has raised $79M since 2023
item.description: Real estate transfer taxes raised more than $152 million for land preservation in the East End towns last year — and $29 million for housing since 2023.

item.title: PFAS found in all produce samples tested from Long Island farms, new study finds
item.description: The PFAS contamination is widespread in the environment, is not limited to Long Island, and not caused by farmers, researchers say.

item.title: Calverton man indicted for murder in stabbing death of his mother
item.description: Curtis Trent Jr., 36, of Calverton, was indicted today for Murder in the Second Degree for the stabbing death of his mother, Kathleen Harrison Trent, 63, of Calverton, Suffolk County District Attorney Raymond A. Tierney announced.

item.title: Supreme Court may take up challenge to New York even-year election law
item.description: A challenge to New York’s law moving most local elections to even years is now before the U.S. Supreme Court.

item.title: Dense fog advisory in effect Saturday morning
item.description: A dense fog advisory is in effect across Long Island through 10 a.m. Saturday, with visibility expected to drop to a quarter-mile or less.
